(1) The Employer contribution shall commence on the 1st of the month following six (6) full months of employment.

(2) Any employee hired by the Employer who was covered by the District Trust Fund as of the date this hire shall have a contribution made on their behalf by the first of the month following the date of hire.

(3) Before the four (4) consecutive calendar weeks referred to in Section A above first occur, the Employer shall make a contribution for the month immediately preceding the first day of the calendar month, which period shall be the period used for determination of continuation of the contribution on consecutive calendar weeks or employment.

C. Effective November 1, 1984, and November 1, 1985, Health and Welfare contributions shall be increased in the amount necessary (if any) to maintain those benefits in effect as of October 23, 1985, now in effect since the last increase.

Such maintenance of benefit increases to be capped to the extent that funds held in reserve by the Trust Fund, in excess of four (4) months reserves, will be first used to offset the required increase in contributions for maintenance of benefits on November 1, 1984, and November 1, 1985.

D. Contributions to the Trust Fund shall be discontinued as of the first of the month following:

1. A layoff or leave of absence of thirty (30) calendar days or more, except as otherwise provided below;

2. The employee's ceasing to be an eligible employee due to his failure to work an average of twenty-four (24) hours or more per week for four (4) consecutive calendar weeks (96 hours).

E. Contributions to the Trust Fund shall be continued under the following conditions:

1. In case of a non-work accident, one (1) month's contribution following the month in which the employee incurred the accident.

2. In case of pregnancy, two (2) months' contribution after the month in which the employee begins her pregnancy leave of absence.

3. In case of illness, two (2) months' contribution following the month in which the illness occurs.

4. In case of compensable injury, three (3) months' contribution following the month in which the injury occurs.

5. The Employer agrees to pay the contributions to the Trust Fund for eligible employees for one (1) month following termination of employment, except for those employees who are discharged for cause.

F. An actuarial study will be made to determine the extent of providing the contributions to the Trust Fund for eligible employees through the Health and Welfare Trust Fund and the Employer may, at his option elect to provide the coverage required under this Section through the Health and Welfare Trust.

G. If the Employer fails to make any contribution as required by the Trustees an employer penalty per incidence shall be assessed.

It is further agreed that if the Administrator becomes necessary to sue the Employer to collect any contribution due hereunder, the Employer shall also be responsible for paying all of the necessary court costs and reasonable attorneys' fees incurred in connection with the collection of such contributions as well, as said ten percent (10%) penalty.

ARTICLE XV
PENSIONS

A. The Employer agrees to contribute in part and contribute to the United Fund and Commercial Workers International Union Industry Pension Trust Fund, which Fund and has shall maintain Treasury Department Approval. Employer will not be obligated to make any contributions to the Fund until the Fund is approved by the Treasury Department.

B. The Employer agrees to contribute to the jointly administered National Pension Trust Fund the sum of one hundred twenty-nine dollars and thirty-one cents ($129.31) per salaried month per eligible employee covered by this Contract.

Effective July 1, 1984 — $ 125.60
July 1, 1985 — $ 134.20
July 1, 1986 — $ 142.80

C. The term "eligible employee" shall mean an employee who has worked an average of twenty-four (24) hours per week for a period of four (4) consecutive calendar weeks (96 hours). Such an employee becomes eligible for participation in the pension program on the first day of the calendar month immediately following the pension program on the first day of the calendar month immediately following the first occurrence of four (4) consecutive calendar weeks (96 hours) and such date hereafter referred to as his eligibility date.

D. Contributions to the Pension Fund shall be discontinued as of the first of the month immediately following:

1. A layoff or leave of absence of thirty (30) calendar days or more, except as otherwise provided below;

2. The employee's ceasing to be an eligible employee due to his failure to work an average of twenty-four (24) hours or more per week for four (4) consecutive calendar weeks (96 hours).

E. Contributions to the Pension Fund, discontinued as set forth in Section D above, shall be resumed as of the first of the month following return from layoff or leave of absence.

F. Contributions to the Pension Fund shall be continued under the following conditions:

1. In case of a non-work accident, one (1) month's contribution following the month in which the employee incurred the accident.

2. In case of pregnancy, two (2) months' contribution after the month in which the employee begins her pregnancy leave of absence.

3. In case of illness, two (2) months' contribution following the month in which the illness occurs.

4. In case of compensable injury, three (3) months' contribution following the month in which the injury occurs.

5. The Employer agrees to pay the contributions to the Pension Fund for eligible employees for one (1) month following termination of employment.

G. When the Employer commences payments into this Pension Fund, the employees covered by this Contract shall automatically cease to participate in the Employer's previous pension plan.

H. The parties to the bargaining agreement for each of the affected employees of the Employer, agrees on behalf of each of the said employees who are not participants in said existing Employer's Retirement Plan, unilaterally established by the Employer, that each of said employees, in consideration of the benefits to be derived from the Pension Fund, hereby agrees to waive, enabling his or her employees to make participation therein, shall withdraw from and surrender, release and relinquish whatever rights, privileges and benefits he, her any, in the Employer's Retirement Plan, effective with the date the Employer commences payment.

ARTICLE XVI
MANAGEMENT RIGHTS

A. The management of the store(s) and direction of the working forces, including the right to plan, direct, expand, reduce and control operations, hire, assign, suspend or discharge for proper cause, to relieve employees from duty because of lack of work or for other proper reasons, the right to introduce any new machinery, equipment or methods of operation, and to make such regulations as may be necessary or desirable for the operation of a store shall be vested exclusively in the Employer.

B. It is expressly understood and agreed that all rights which the Employer had prior to the execution of this Agreement, except where explicitly limited by the terms of this Agreement, are preserved and shall continue to be vested in the Employer. In the event any rules or regulations and regulations are promulgated, the Employer agrees that it will furnish copies of such rules and regulations to the Union, and with other post them on the bulletin boards or supply each employee with a copy.
